title: Lab 02 — Data Types and Labelling for ML
description: Classify structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, store samples in Amazon S3, and produce a labelled image dataset with SageMaker Ground Truth.

steps.title: Step 1: Classify structured, semi-structured and unstructured data
